newsitem.title: USA: Apple CEO paid nearly $3 mln this year.
newsitem.headline: Apple CEO paid nearly $3 mln this year.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc paid Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Gilbert Amelio nearly $3 million in fiscal 1996 while outgoing Chief Executive Michael Spindler received a total of $4.66 million.

According to the company's annual proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Amelio's compensation could rise substantially if he can turn the troubled computer maker around, reflecting the value of stock options and performance shares.

If Apple's shares rise five percent a year for the next five years, Apple said Amelio's option to buy one million shares of Apple stock would be worth $16.5 million. If the stock rises 10 percent, the options would be worth $41.8 million.

The options have an exercise price of $26.25, making them virtually worthless right now because Apple's stock price is only $23.125. However, if the former National Semiconductor Corp chief executive can revitalise Apple, the options could become quite valuable.

According to the company's proxy statement, Amelio, who replaced Spindler in February, received a base salary of $655,061 in fiscal 1996 and a bonus of $2.334 million, bringing his total cash compensation to $2.99 million.

In setting the bonus amount, Apple said Amelio met or exceeded six of the eight targets established by the board of directors' compensation committee. The targets include such goals as targets for revenue growth and gross margin, building a new management team, establishing Apple's strategy and restructuring its business lines.

In addition to the cash portion of Amelio's compensation package, he also received 130,960 so-called performance shares, which the company estimated to be worth about $3.83 million on February 2, 1996, and stock options for one million additional shares of Apple stock.
Apple said Spindler earned a total of $4.66 million in compensation this year, including a base salary of $557,076, a bonus of $382,500, and severance payments totaling $3.72 million.
